documents_expected.why: how to apply and the timeline
application handbook: tables, attachments, contribution agreement documents

eligibility.rule: Non-profits based or operating in Manitoba, and Indigenous governments
eligibility.quote: Community-based not-for-profit groups - Provincially-based not-for-profit groups - National not-for-profit groups that have established operations within Manitoba - Indigenous governments or representative groups (ex. Band councils or tribal councils)

eligibility.rule: No other governments, individuals or for-profits as applicants
eligibility.quote: Organizations without established operations in Manitoba - Governments (with the exception of Indigenous governments) - Individuals - For-profit organizations
Project sites located on public and private lands within Manitoba's working landscapes

eligibility.rule: Up to $600,000 per organisation across categories
eligibility.quote: Organizations may apply to the Conservation Trust for up to $600,000 in total funding across the six categories listed below.

eligibility.rule: Projects of up to two years
eligibility.quote: Groups may submit applications for up to two years for project activities.

eligibility.rule: Existing grantees behind on projects or reports may be barred
eligibility.quote: Grant recipients with existing funded projects may be restricted from re-applying if those projects are substantially behind in their activities or reporting.

eligibility.rule: Written landowner agreements for work on land the grantee doesn't own
eligibility.quote: All activities occurring on properties not owned or controlled by the grantee will be supported by written agreements between the grantee and the landowner.

documents.item: Online eligibility quiz and letter of interest
documents.quote: Complete the Online Eligibility Quiz Fill this out in the online portal Complete the Letter of Interest (LOI)

documents.item: Table package: project information, budget, workplan and outputs (Excel)
documents.quote: Table A. Project Information Table B. Project Budget Table C. Project Workplan Table D. Project Outputs
Supporting documents such as maps and site photos may be attached if applicable.

documents.item: By-laws or board resolution naming signing authority (at agreement)
documents.quote: Copy of organization's by-laws or a board resolution identifying signing authority for your organization

documents.item: Certificate of insurance naming MHC as additional insured (at agreement)
documents.quote: New certificate of insurance evidencing the addition of Manitoba Habitat Heritage Corporation as an additional insured.

documents.item: Possibly: board list, annual budget, up to three years of financial statements
documents.quote: Organizational financial statements (up to last three years if available and applicable)

documents.item: Possibly: partner MOU, letters of support and confirmation of funding sources
documents.quote: Signed memorandum of understanding between project partner(s) that clearly outlines the partner roles and responsibilities
alt_quotes: Written confirmation of all funding sources

effort.step: Register the organisation in the Online Grant Portal
effort.quote: Enter the Online Grant Portal to register.
Letter of Interest Intake Closes October 2, 2026

effort.step: If invited, submit the full application
Sign the contribution agreement before the first payment
effort.quote: The first payment will be released after the Contribution Agreement is signed.

co_finance_required.quote: Projects with less than a 2:1 match ratio may be considered and ranked accordingly

after_award.quote: One-Year Projects N/A April 30th, 2028 Two-Year Projects April 30th, 2028 April 30th, 2029

notes: Two stages: letter of interest (closed 2 October 2026), then a full application by invitation. A match of at least twice the request (the Trust covering up to a third of the cost) is expected and scored, but lower matches can still be considered; no more than half the match from provincial sources. Category caps: $600,000 for habitat, watersheds and soil health; $100,000 innovation; $75,000 connecting people to nature; $25,000 planning. One-year projects file only a final report. Books kept for 7 years.
